description: Sleep-safe first fixer wave selected from morphoeval/problem_scouts/leaderboard.json. Each task is one isolated PR. Auto-merge is restricted to deterministic, narrow-scope tasks; all other completed work remains in a PR for human review.

tasks.title: DATA-QUALITY: catalog bioelectric_polarity empirical curves are alpha-template artifacts (BIO-TPL-DQ-01)
instructions: Determine from primary in-repo evidence whether the three named bioelectric_polarity empirical curves are actually alpha_scale templates rather than biological observations.
Do not fabricate replacement biological data and do not silently overwrite empirical_series values.

If the claim is confirmed, quarantine it in a durable machine-readable way: add a focused checker plus a data-quality audit artifact that names every affected dataset, the exact correlations, and which downstream claims must not cite those curves as biological evidence.

If a legitimate non-template biological source is already present and merely mislabelled, correct only the provenance labelling and cite the source record; if replacement data would have to be invented or fetched ambiguously, report blocked instead of guessing.

validators.name: python syntax for any new fixers tooling

tasks.title: OEIS A051023 center-column traceability (first 128 bits)
instructions: Independently recompute the Rule 30 center column and compare the first 128 bits with the vendored OEIS fixture.

Create a separate, clearly timestamped registration/resolution pair for R30-OEIS-128-01; do not edit predictions/prediction_registry.json or predictions/prediction_registry.csv and do not describe this as a blind biological prediction.
Include the SHA-256 of the expected 128-bit sequence, the exact code path used, and a machine-readable verdict.

tasks.title: Cross-artifact viability sync: open-problems.json vs problem-graph DELPHI vs audit YAML
instructions: Build the verifier at morphoeval/problem_scouts/verify_rule30_delphi_sync.py, comparing OP-01 through OP-03 across open-problems.json, the generated problem graph, and the audit YAML source of truth.
Run the canonical builders first; repair drift only in generated/derived artifacts or in the verifier's extraction logic. Do not change Delphi scores by hand.
The verifier must fail loudly with the offending prediction IDs and observed values when tolerances are exceeded.

validators.name: Delphi sync focused tests when added

tasks.title: Newman 1979 limb dataset: scout_manifest seed DOI is a typo vs reference/bib
instructions: Verify the Newman & Frisch 1979 primary-source DOI against Crossref or the publisher record; do not assume the candidate's preferred DOI merely because two repo files agree.
Correct the erroneous provenance field at the narrowest source of truth and record both the old and corrected DOI plus title evidence in the fixer report.
Search for hashes or generated references inside the allowed dataset that pin the changed file; if a required update falls outside the allowlist, stop as blocked and name it.

validators.name: DOI provenance consistency
argv: import json,re,pathlib; m=json.load(open('datasets/limb_chondrogenesis_turing/scout_manifest.json')); r=json.load(open('datasets/limb_chondrogenesis_turing/limb_chondrogenesis_turing_reference.json')); b=pathlib.Path('datasets/limb_chondrogenesis_turing/paper_citations.bib').read_text(); doi='10.1126/science.462174'; assert doi in b; print(m.get('seed_doi') or m.get('territory',{}).get('seed_doi') or 'see report', doi)

tasks.title: Global morphogenetic flow: scout seed DOI mismatches the Streichan 2018 eLife bib entry
instructions: Identify the actual Streichan et al. 2018 Global morphogenetic flow article from Crossref/eLife and reconcile scout_manifest seed_doi with the primary bib entry and seed_landmark_paper.
Correct only the erroneous provenance field; preserve any genuinely distinct citing DOI as a secondary citation rather than deleting evidence.
Record both DOIs, article title evidence, and the reason one is primary in the fixer report.

validators.name: GMF DOI consistency
argv: import json,pathlib; m=json.load(open('datasets/global_morphogenetic_flow/scout_manifest.json')); b=pathlib.Path('datasets/global_morphogenetic_flow/paper_citations.bib').read_text(); assert '10.7554/eLife.27454' in b; print(m)

tasks.title: Audit `script:` path silently drops six Turing reference measurements
instructions: Diagnose whether the correct repair is canonical audit script paths, a resolver in measure_outputs.py, or both; prefer the smallest repair that makes measurement complete without rewriting scientific scores.
Regenerate the affected measurement sidecars with the repo tool rather than hand-editing computed values.
Prove that the Pearson 1993 and Kondo reference rows are present and that missing/broken paths fail visibly rather than silently producing a partial four-row result.

validators.name: Measurement completeness check
argv: import yaml; m=yaml.safe_load(open('morphoeval/audits/2026-10-19-turing-audit-v2.measurements.yaml')); rows=m['measurements']['turing-gray-scott']; assert len(rows)>=10, len(rows); src=' '.join(str(x.get('reference_source','')) for x in rows); assert 'Pearson 1993' in src and 'Kondo' in src; print(len(rows))

tasks.title: Planarian HK-ATPase v2 sidecar still pins superseded specimen SHA-256 and morphology text
instructions: Reconcile the v2 sidecar, scout_manifest, and README with the live specimen bytes and dimensions. Regenerate measured values with repo tools; do not hand-type hashes or morphometrics.
Do not replace the specimen image in this task. If the live image itself is taxonomically wrong, report that separately as blocked rather than fetching a substitute.
Cite the live SHA-256 and dimensions in the fixer report and show which stale text was removed.

validators.name: Specimen digest is present in sidecar
argv: import hashlib,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path('datasets/planarian_hk_atpase_anterior/schmidtea_mediterranea_specimen.jpg'); d=hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(); s=pathlib.Path('morphoeval/audits/2026-10-19-planarian-hk-atpase-anterior-audit-v2.measurements.yaml').read_text(); assert d in s, d; print(d)

tasks.title: Zhang sorting morphogenesis: fix math_kg lean_code snippets to match structural Loop theorems
instructions: Mirror the actual quantified theorem signatures from Loop_zhang_sorting_morphogenesis.lean in the math-KG lean_code fields.
Do not weaken verify_integrity.py and do not alter theorem statements merely to pass the gate.
If a KG rebuild is generated, include only artifacts directly produced by the documented tool route and explain them in the report.

tasks.title: Cervera gap-junction GIF missing from audit fingerprints
instructions: Create a superseding Cervera audit version that cites docs/media/cervera_levin_mafe_gj_block.gif correctly; do not rewrite the historical v2 audit as if it had always been correct.
Generate the measurement sidecar with measure_outputs.py and verify the GIF entry has a SHA-256 and at least 24 frames with no missing simulation output.
State explicitly what v3 supersedes and what scientific conclusions, if any, changed.

validators.name: Python syntax for any new fixers tooling

tasks.title: Planform damaged-negative fixtures not gated in MorphoEval CI
instructions: Add a standard pytest gate that exercises all five damaged-negative fixtures and their expected error codes without mutating the committed fixtures.
Include a negative-control style test on temporary copies so a flipped expected_error_code is detected as a test failure by construction, while the normal suite remains green.
Do not modify GitHub workflow files in this task; making the test discoverable by the repo's standard pytest validation is the deliverable.

tasks.title: Mechanical semantic gate: YAML `formula` tokens must appear in paired Lean defs
instructions: Implement morphoeval/check_lean_formula_alignment.py as a semantic alignment checker, not a token-count trick.
The checker must include a --self-test mode proving the documented positive control passes and the documented overnight-template negative control fails.
Do not mass-relabel or mass-rewrite the 3,000 placeholder YAML/Lean files in this task; report the pilot findings and the safe rollout path.

validators.name: Lean formula alignment focused tests when added

tasks.title: Machine-check DM-DPP-01 precursor vs mature Dpp mobility factors (0.61 / 0.78)
instructions: Read the mature-chain and precursor lengths directly from sequences/sequence_links.json and encode the registered DM-DPP-01 arithmetic without changing the locked prediction registry.
Prove the stated mobility and length-scale factors within explicit tolerances in a standalone Lean file with zero sorry declarations.
If Lean is unavailable in the environment, create the file plus a Python cross-check and mark the fixer result blocked on kernel verification rather than claiming Lean success.

validators.name: No sorry term in Lean certificate
argv: import re; from pathlib import Path; s=Path('morphoeval/lean/loops/Loop_prediction_DM_DPP_01_dpp_mobility_ratio.lean').read_text(); s=re.sub(r'--.*', '', s); assert not re.search(r'(?<![A-Za-z_])sorry(?:Ax)?(?![A-Za-z_])', s); print('no sorry term')
